## Details

<a id="menu_hit_table"></a>
### [`menu_hit_table`](../../../../src/data/menu_zoom_hit_tables.asm#L6) `$25C8`

*data*

Hit table of the main menu: a count, then 5 bytes for each cell: Y max, Y min, X end (exclusive), X min, code. Codes $01-$11 are the commands, $40-$5f the colours, $80-$8e the brushes.

<a id="zoom_hit_table"></a>
### [`zoom_hit_table`](../../../../src/data/menu_zoom_hit_tables.asm#L66) `$26E6`

*data*

Hit table of the Zoom screen: 19 cells. Code 2: Y $00-$2f, code 3: Y $30-$47 (X $00-$9e); code 1: Y $4c-$af, X $0c-$92; codes $40-$4f: the 16 colours at Y $b0-$c7. The zoom code at $3020 uses it.
